zh: 添加百度网盘时，可在复古猫内打开百度官方登录页并用手机扫码。
点击已添加的百度网盘会进入云端目录设置，可从更多菜单重新授权。移除同步源会解除对应的目录和存档同步关联，保留本机和网盘文件。
修复了另一屏仍有应用运行时，退出上屏应用后复古猫无响应、手柄按键和摇杆失效的问题。
双屏中只有一屏显示复古猫主界面时，游戏库会在当前屏显示游戏详情和卡带模型。
en: Add Baidu Netdisk by opening Baidu’s official sign-in page in RetroMao and scanning the QR code with your phone.

Tap a saved Baidu Netdisk source to open its cloud folder settings, and use the More menu to reauthorize. Removing a sync source disconnects its folders and save sync while keeping local and cloud files.
Fixed an issue that could leave RetroMao unresponsive or block controller buttons and sticks after closing an app on the upper screen while another app keeps running below.
When only one of the two screens shows the RetroMao main interface, that screen displays game details and cartridge models.
